features.name: log_amount
features.definition: log1p of positive canonical amount

features.name: vendor_amount_ratio
features.definition: amount / prior same-currency submitted vendor median

features.name: employee_category_ratio
features.definition: amount / prior same-currency submitted employee/category median

features.name: robust_amount_z
features.definition: absolute amount deviation / (1.4826 * median absolute deviation)

features.name: po_value_ratio
features.definition: current amount / pinned remaining PO value

features.name: price_variance_ratio
features.definition: absolute line-price difference / comparable expected line total

features.name: receipt_shortfall
features.definition: positive billed quantity minus verified available acceptance

features.name: policy_limit_ratio
features.definition: comparable policy-unit amount / pinned allowance

features.name: budget_utilization_after
features.definition: projected same-basis exposure / allocated budget

features.name: max_duplicate_similarity
features.definition: highest completed comparable candidate similarity, 0 only for completed no-match search

features.name: min_phash_distance
features.definition: closest actual comparable 64-bit image hash distance

features.name: same_amount_count_30d
features.definition: prior cohort submissions at the same exact amount in 30 business days

features.name: days_since_previous
features.definition: business-date days since most recent prior cohort submission

features.name: vendor_tenure_days
features.definition: days since explicitly recorded approved onboarding date

features.name: payment_account_changed
features.definition: verified requested account differs from approved master; no account token in vector

features.name: claims_near_limit_7d
features.definition: prior comparable policy-unit claims with ratio in [0.9,1.0] in 7 days

features.name: submission_delay_days
features.definition: actual submitted business-local date minus canonical business date

features.name: quality_and_freshness
features.definition: fraction of known critical source observations unresolved; absent source metrics are missing

features.name: history_count
features.definition: number of prior submitted comparable canonical observations

features.name: cold_start
features.definition: complete cohort has fewer than 5 observations, or history coverage is incomplete

history_semantics: prior submitted facts, never clean/paid labels
